paper_title: Easily Available High-Performance Organic Solar Cells by Regulating Phenylalkyl Side Groups of Non-Fused Ring Electron Acceptors
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Wang - Easily Available High‐Performance Organic Solar Cells by Regulating Phenylalkyl Side/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2023 - Wang - Easily Available High‐Performance Organic Solar Cells by Regulating Phenylalkyl Side.md

knowledge_points.content: A series of non-fused ring electron acceptors (NFREAs) named BOR-CnPh (n = 3, 4, and 6) were synthesized by incorporating phenylalkyl side groups onto the dithiophene cyclopentadiene (DTC) moieties.
knowledge_points.evidence: Herein, phenylalkyl category side groups (CnPh) are employed to construct new NFREAs named BOR-CnPh (n = 3, 4, and 6)... the BOR-CnPh acceptors carry phenylalkyl side groups in the dithiophene cyclopentadiene (DTC) moieties.

knowledge_points.content: The as-cast organic solar cell based on the PBDB-T:BOR-C4Ph blend achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 13.12%, with a VOC of 0.827 V, a JSC of 22.67 mA cm^-2, and a fill factor (FF) of 70.03%.
knowledge_points.evidence: the pristine PBDB-T:BOR-C4Ph blend delivers intrinsic fibrous networks with dominating face-on orientation, which yields an optimal efficiency up to 13.12%... with open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.827 V, short-circuit current density (JSC) of 22.67 mA cm-2, and FF of 70.03%.

knowledge_points.content: The length of the alkyl spacer in the phenylalkyl side chain dictates the molecular orientation: BOR-C3Ph exhibits disordered stacking, BOR-C4Ph shows a distinct face-on orientation, and BOR-C6Ph displays weak aggregation and low crystallinity.
knowledge_points.evidence: strong aggregation but disordered orientations for BOR-C3Ph, strong aggregation and face-on orientations for BOR-C4Ph, and weak aggregation and disordered orientations for BOR-C6Ph.

knowledge_points.content: BOR-CnPh acceptors exhibit significantly larger bathochromic shifts (>80 nm) in film compared to solution than the branched alkyl analog DOC2C6-2F (<40 nm), indicating enhanced molecular aggregation due to the phenylalkyl side groups.
knowledge_points.evidence: Compared to solution states, notable bathochromic shifts of over 80 nm were found in BOR-CnPh films, which are significantly larger than that of DOC2C6-2F with less than 40 nm offset.

knowledge_points.content: The PBDB-T:BOR-C3Ph system requires chloroform (CF) as a processing solvent to achieve a PCE of 10.36%, whereas processing with chlorobenzene (CB) leads to excessive phase separation and a low PCE of 4.16% due to limited solubility.
knowledge_points.evidence: Therefore, CF was employed to cast PBDB-T:BOR-C3Ph blend, which yields an increased PCE of 10.36%... the inefficient PCE of PBDB-T:BOR-C3Ph [in CB] is probably ascribed to the extremely serious phase-separation.

knowledge_points.content: The PBDB-T:BOR-C4Ph as-cast device exhibits superior thermal stability, retaining 86% of its initial PCE after being heated at 65 °C for over 200 hours.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PBDB-T:BOR-C4Ph device retains 86% of its initial PCE, whereas the other devices showed larger decays to 70% (PBDB-T:BOR-C3Ph) and 77% (PBDB-T:BOR-C6Ph) in the same duration.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis reveals that the BOR-C4Ph neat film has a pi-pi stacking distance of 0.34 nm and a coherence length (CCL) of 4.90 nm, which are more compact and ordered than the branched alkyl analog DOC2C6-2F.
knowledge_points.evidence: the pi-pi stacking CCL of BOR-C4Ph was calculated to be 4.90 nm, with distance spacing (d_pi-pi) of 0.34 nm... all the three BOR-CnPh have more compact pi-pi stacking and greater CCL than those of their analog DOC2C6-2F.

knowledge_points.content: The PBDB-T:BOR-C4Ph device demonstrates the most balanced charge transport among the studied NFREAs, with hole and electron mobilities of 5.68 x 10^-4 and 3.28 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: Notably, the PBDB-T:BOR-C4Ph device deliver the highest mu_h and the most balanced charge transport capacity... [Table 2: 5.68/3.28 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1].

knowledge_points.content: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations show that BOR-CnPh molecules maintain good planarity with dihedral angles of 10-12 degrees between the central phenyl and adjacent DTC motifs, stabilized by O...S noncovalent interactions.
knowledge_points.evidence: All the three molecules possess good molecular planarity with dihedral angles of 10-12° between the central phenyl and adjacent DTC motifs, attributed to the lock effect of multiple O...S noncovalent interactions.
